idea-plugin.name: Dependency Checker
idea-plugin.description:
Dependency checker for package.json, composer.json and requirements.txt. On the sample package.json (Angular 19 + Express API, _fixtures/dirty.json) checked on 2026-09-28 it finds six dependencies past or near end of support: express ^4.21.2 (EOL target 2026-10-01), @angular/core ^19.2.0 (ended 2026-05-19), eslint ^8.57.0 (ended 2024-10-05), bootstrap ^4.6.2 (ended 2023-01-01), angular 1.8.3 (ended 2021-12-31), request ^2.88.2 (deprecated 2020-02-11).

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Dependency Checker: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 19 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/dependency-checker-eol-dates (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/dependency-checker-eol-dates

action.description: Run Dependency Checker on the file in the editor
